name: Loco Locca
source:
I am at unfamiliar tower.
Why am I here? I should have been at the monastery.
While I was confused, a teddy bear calling himself agent of god gave me a hint.
Yes, I remembered. I came here to exorcise the Demon.

[translated from official website]
